science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: [MIDDAY_EXPEDITION at Basalt_Spire_Ridge] Hector stood at the precipice of the jagged basalt ridge, watching the dark, swirling expanse of the ferrofluid sea below as the sky above shifted hues in the harsh midday light. He could feel the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea pulling at the very iron in his blood, the intense magnetic friction making the air hum with a static tang on his tongue and his skin prickle with the oppressive heat. The deafening roar of the clashing magnetic waves masked the grinding of the brass and copper calibration baton in his hands, which he clenched tight against the violent wind. Spotting Kaio scaling the treacherous ridge to collect the readings, he DEFENDed his precarious footing on the slick rock, preparing to make the physical baton handoff.
